summary: Four-legged Pope County lookout, about 85 feet high, described in a 1954 survey; listed as removed, and no source describes the site today.

facts.design: Four-legged tower about 85 feet high supporting a house about six feet by six feet (1954 survey description)
facts.status_note: Listed as removed; no source describes what remains at the site today.

notes_for_editor: Single source: a 1954 Coast and Geodetic Survey station description (PID FG1806) reproduced on the Forest Lookouts page. The page header reads Turnpike Freeman Springs, and Freeman Springs did not appear in any of the two web searches, so the second name is unexplained. The record height of 25.9 m matches the 85 ft in the survey. Build date, removal date and current site are all unknown. Two searches for a Turnpike or Freeman Springs lookout returned nothing. Worth checking NGS datasheet PID FG1806 and Ozark National Forest records.
